chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The continuation (of fasting) is that he makes his dinner his pre-dawn meal.

key_terms.الْوِصَالُ: Continuous fasting, specifically fasting without breaking the fast at night to eat Suhoor

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of Visal fasting in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from Al-Kafi defines 'Al-Wisal' as the practice of linking the evening meal directly to the pre-dawn meal without an intervening break, thereby extending the fast continuously. This definition highlights the specific condition of omitting the distinct Suhoor interval, a point of discussion among jurists regarding whether it constitutes a disliked act (Makruh) or requires expiation depending on the school of thought.
